title: Sandy City Cemetery Graves
description: Provides access to the Sandy City, Utah Cemetery data. 11,695 multipolygon features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Esri object identifier. A row number assigned by the source geodatabase and reassigned when the layer is republished. It is not a stable key and must not be used to join across collections or across refreshes.

table:columns.name: Grave_ID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the grave plot within the cemetery.

table:columns.name: BurialID
table:columns.description: Identifier of the burial record.

table:columns.name: Section
table:columns.description: Cemetery section the plot lies in.

table:columns.name: Section_Lot
table:columns.description: Section and lot, concatenated.

table:columns.name: Section_Lot_Grave
table:columns.description: Full plot address as section, lot and grave.

table:columns.name: Status
table:columns.description: Operational status of the feature. See the measured values below, because the source layer declares no code list. Measured in the published file: Populated on 100% of 11,695 rows, 6 distinct values, ranging 1 to 9.

table:columns.name: Deceased
table:columns.description: Name of the person buried, as recorded in the register.

table:columns.name: LastName
table:columns.description: Surname of the person buried.

table:columns.name: FirstMidName
table:columns.description: Given and middle names of the person buried.

table:columns.name: Death_Place
table:columns.description: Place of death, as recorded.

table:columns.name: Race
table:columns.description: Race as written in the register. This is a historical record and reflects the categories and language of the time it was written, not current usage. Populated on 65% of rows.

table:columns.name: Birthplace
table:columns.description: Place of birth, as recorded.

table:columns.name: Father
table:columns.description: Father's name, as recorded.

table:columns.name: Father_Nationality
table:columns.description: Father's nationality, as recorded.

table:columns.name: Mother
table:columns.description: Mother's name, as recorded.

table:columns.name: Mother_Nationality
table:columns.description: Mother's nationality, as recorded.

table:columns.name: BIRTH_MO
table:columns.description: Month of birth as a number. Zero where unrecorded.

table:columns.name: BIRTH_DAY
table:columns.description: Day of birth. Zero where unrecorded.

table:columns.name: BIRTH_YEAR
table:columns.description: Year of birth. Zero where the register does not record it; 4,889 of 11,695 rows carry a usable year, ranging 1800 to 2015.

table:columns.name: BirthDate
table:columns.description: Date of birth as a single value, where the register records a complete date.

table:columns.name: DEATH_MO
table:columns.description: Month of death as a number. Zero where unrecorded.

table:columns.name: DEATH_DAY
table:columns.description: Day of death. Zero where unrecorded.

table:columns.name: DEATH_YEAR
table:columns.description: Year of death. Zero where unrecorded.

table:columns.name: DeathDate
table:columns.description: Date of death as a single value.

table:columns.name: BURIAL_MO
table:columns.description: Month of burial as a number. Zero where unrecorded.

table:columns.name: BURIAL_DAY
table:columns.description: Day of burial. Zero where unrecorded.

table:columns.name: BURIAL_YEAR
table:columns.description: Year of burial. Zero where unrecorded.

table:columns.name: BurialDate
table:columns.description: Date of burial as a single value.

table:columns.name: Burial_Receipt_Num
table:columns.description: Receipt number for the burial fee. Some values resemble telephone numbers; they are receipt numbers.

table:columns.name: Burial_Amount_Paid
table:columns.description: Fee paid for the burial, in dollars.

table:columns.name: Social_Status_old
table:columns.description: Earlier value of the status field, kept from a previous version of the register.

table:columns.name: Social_Status
table:columns.description: Marital or family status at death.

table:columns.name: Gender
table:columns.description: Sex of the person buried, as recorded.

table:columns.name: Cause_of_Death
table:columns.description: Cause of death, as written in the register.

table:columns.name: Veteran
table:columns.description: Veteran marker. 1 indicates a veteran burial, 0 indicates not, and -1 indicates the register does not say. Populated on 67% of rows.

table:columns.name: Service
table:columns.description: Branch of military service, where the person served.

table:columns.name: Rank
table:columns.description: Military rank, where recorded.

table:columns.name: Unit
table:columns.description: Unit of the adjacent measurement column. Measured in the published file: Populated on 0% of 11,695 rows, 44 distinct values.

table:columns.name: Conflict
table:columns.description: Conflict the person served in, where recorded.

table:columns.name: EnteredBy
table:columns.description: Staff member who entered the record.

table:columns.name: Last_Update
table:columns.description: When the register row was last updated.

table:columns.name: Comments
table:columns.description: Free-text note entered by city staff. Unstructured and inconsistently populated.

table:columns.name: On_the_Headstone
table:columns.description: Inscription transcribed from the headstone.

table:columns.name: Notes_Landmarks
table:columns.description: Note describing how to find the plot on the ground.

table:columns.name: Mortuary
table:columns.description: Mortuary that handled the burial.

table:columns.name: Mortuary_Phone
table:columns.description: Business telephone number of the mortuary.

table:columns.name: Ownership
table:columns.description: Who owns the asset. Sandy's utility layers include assets owned by other cities, the county, UDOT and private parties. Empty in all 11,695 rows of the published file.

table:columns.name: CremationFlag
table:columns.description: Whether the interment is a cremation.

table:columns.name: Spouse
table:columns.description: Spouse's name, as recorded.

table:columns.name: LocatedBy
table:columns.description: Staff member who located the plot on the ground.

table:columns.name: VerifiedBy
table:columns.description: Staff member who verified the record.

table:columns.name: Headstone_Mon_Placed_YN
table:columns.description: Whether a headstone or monument has been placed on the plot.

table:columns.name: Headstone_Mon_Placed_Date
table:columns.description: Date the headstone or monument was placed.

table:columns.name: Monument_Co
table:columns.description: Company that supplied the headstone or monument.

table:columns.name: Monument_Co_Phone
table:columns.description: Business telephone number of that company.

table:columns.name: Shape__Area
table:columns.description: Polygon area computed by the geodatabase, in the square units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it, because it is not updated when a shape is edited.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: Line length or polygon perimeter computed by the geodatabase, in the units of the source coordinate system. Recompute it from the geometry rather than trusting it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, WKB encoded, in the collection's `proj:epsg` coordinate system.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box written by gpio, as a struct of `xmin`, `ymin`, `xmax`, `ymax`, in the same coordinate system as the geometry. Rows are in Hilbert order, so filtering on this column prunes row groups efficiently.
